newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 182nd JGB yield falls to record low 2.315 pct.
newsitem.headline: Key 182nd JGB yield falls to record low 2.315 pct.

text.p: The benchmark 182nd 10-year JGB yield fall to a record low of 2.315 percent in late Tokyo trade on Tuesday.
The previous low was 2.320 percent hit earlier on Tuesday.
Local banks' desire to boost their JGB holdings ahead of book closings at the end of March was a factor behind the JGBs' steady gains, traders said.
Foreign funds, which actively unloaded JGBs over the past month, were absent from the market, underscoring the bullish sentiment for JGBs, they added.
